name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam's motorsport journey began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, fueled by late nights watching races from Europe and the Americas. He honed his skills through a mechanical engineering degree at the University of Auckland, followed by a stint in the V8 Supercars championship, where he quickly rose through the ranks to become a lead engineer. His meticulous attention to detail and data-driven approach caught the eye of AF Corse, who recruited him as their technical director.

Liam is known for his ability to identify and solve complex technical problems, often working late into the night analyzing telemetry data. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment within his team, encouraging open communication and knowledge sharing. While respected for his technical prowess, Liam's ambition extends beyond simply optimizing the existing car; he has a vision for pushing the boundaries of performance through innovative design and engineering solutions. He is driven to win, and is always looking for ways to make that happen.

physical.description: A lean man of average height, Liam often sports a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee throughout the day.
